profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Machine Learning Team at Elastic
profile.summary:
When I'm not getting my hands dirty creating a sweet, sweet interface with some OO JavaScript, reveling in the simple beauty of Ruby, or working on solving problems through code, you can find me watching futbol or listening to JavaScript podcasts. 

Web development is something that engages every part of my mind and, through it, I feel that I now have the tools to truly make a change - the possibilities are endless. 

Skills:
Ruby, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, JQuery, PHP, CI, React, Redux, AJAX, HTML5, CSS, Git, Heroku, AWS, RSpec, Jasmine

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Team
Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Worked on Buffer's single page web application, API and browser extensions utilizing PHP and Backbone.

Collaborated on components and web-components npm packages - shared, reusable set of UI components using React.

Currently collaborating on breaking down Buffer - a monolithic PHP application - into microservices using Kubernetes, Docker, React, and Node.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web Development utilizing Ruby/Rails and JavaScript on a large distributed ecosystem which provides a variety of services for prisons and inmates including video chat/visits, VOIP phones, verification of user identity, and secure payment processing services. 

Analyzing and developing embeddable contact management application designed to allow users to access their contacts and related activities from any company application. 

Primarily responsible for the management of a third-party integration system to import inmate data through internal and external APIs and S/FTP

Experience in debugging and providing support for core applications providing company services.

positions.title: Dev Bootcamp Graduate
positions.description:
Dev Bootcamp is a time of intensive immersion in the world of Software Engineering. This program gave me a solid base for a successful career in Web Development and, more importantly, allowed me to develop my ability to learn new technologies extremely quickly and efficiently. I dedicated more than 1500 hours over the last 3 months to self-guided learning, individual coding challenges and projects, pair-programming, and group projects. 

 I created web applications in Ruby and Javascript using MVC and object-oriented design patterns,
 made use of Agile Development and Git for version control, attended and participated in 
 Engineering Empathy, and practiced TDD and BDD using RSpec, Jasmine, and Capybara.

Technologies and concepts covered:

• Javascript, JQuery
• Ruby, Sinatra, Rails, Ruby Gems, Pry
• HTML5, CSS3, Handlebars, Sass, Haml
• ActiveRecord, SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite
• RSpec, Jasmine, Capybara, Factory Girl
• Git, Github, Heroku
• Agile Development, Engineering Empathy
• Googling, Debugging, Pseudocoding

positions.title: Recovery Counselor
positions.locationName: Thunder Road Adolescent Treatment Center, Inc. Oakland, CA
positions.description:
Taught basic life skills such as stress and time management, recovery skills, problem solving, relaxation, communication, and assertiveness and refusal skills.

Accountable for maintaining charts and clinical documentations on a daily basis.

Assisted in the facilitation of psycho-educational groups such as Relapse Prevention, Alcohol
and Other Drugs, Anger Management, 12 Step.

Maintained clinical documentation (progress notes, individualized treatment plans).

Handled client escalations and provided appropriate corrective actions.

positions.title: Library Assistant
positions.description:
Provided assistance to library patrons in regards to circulation and readers’ advisory services.

Hands on experience in information retrieval and general library management.

In depth knowledge of methods to locate resources for patrons.

Organized readers’ groups to encourage young readers’ participation and interest in libraries.

Maintained records.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Answer client calls and address their queries and concerns within the assigned timelines.

Aid in the developing process improvements to improve response times and service quality.

Schedule regular client appointments and provide referrals and information on products and services.

Manage patient records and perform data entry services.
